status: declared by the pull request that closes #524 (criterion 3, finding #518) before any refit was computed; reported only, nothing here changes the judge's declaration, a tier, a cut-off rule, a model or any published figure

rows.reading: the five risk-date models that meet tier 1 (docs/pivot/risk-date-severity-result.md), each as metadata/risk_date_severity.json declares it

share: the period's scored days over all scored days on the h = 1 grid, as metadata/setup_sensitivity.json (#482) computed it (an after-the-fact quantity: this is a sensitivity reading, not a rule)
weights: setup_sensitivity.downweights over the label days of a fit's risk-date training pairs: every pair in the period weighs the same, the period's pairs together weigh the period's share of the fit's total weight, pairs outside weigh 1; a fit whose pairs are all on one side weighs every pair 1

readings.declared: the model as declared, the judge's cut-off rule as declared
readings.cutoff_only: the model as declared, the flag cut-off chosen with the period's days down-weighted (#482's reading)
readings.refit: the model refitted with the weights, the judge's cut-off rule as declared
readings.refit_and_cutoff: the model refitted with the weights and the cut-off chosen with the same weights

weights_by_window: the weight on a 2018-19 day in each refit's training window, by the calendar year in which the refit window ends, so that where the weighting is the identity is shown rather than assumed
what_it_cannot_say: a training window that holds only 2018-19 days (every refit that ends before 2020) has nothing to rebalance against; the rule weighs every pair 1 there, and no re-weighting of those windows can change a warning in 2018 or 2019. The reading is reported for the years in which the weights are not 1.
